Implemented in worktree /Users/joeoakhart/90cb-bare-exempt (branch 90cb-bare-exempt, off gerrit main 5e1343be).

Derivation chosen: two constants emitted by gen_types.py into rebar.types —
  PLAN_REVIEW_BUG_TIER_TYPES = frozenset({"bug"})
  PLAN_REVIEW_BARE_EXEMPT_TYPES = PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES - PLAN_REVIEW_BUG_TIER_TYPES

workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck consumes both: the short-circuit tests membership in
PLAN_REVIEW_BARE_EXEMPT_TYPES, and the two `ticket_type == "bug"` comparisons became a single
`bug_tier = ticket_type in PLAN_REVIEW_BUG_TIER_TYPES` local, so the module now carries ZERO
ticket-type string literals (AC1 in its strong form).

Verification: RED captured first (ImportError at collection, then the two AC1 tests failing
against the unchanged module). Five mutants all killed — bug re-entering the bare-exempt set,
identity dropped at the call site, the bug-tier arm disabled, the hardcoded tuple restored, and
the bug-tier set widened to a non-exempt type. make lint exit 0 (mechanism + complexity ratchets
new=0 increased=0), make typecheck clean, generator round-trip clean. pytest tests/unit -k
"plan_review or workflow_ops or exempt" = 1171 passed / 4 skipped.

Pre-existing unrelated failure on this base ref (reproduced on the stashed clean tree, NOT caused
by this change): tests/unit/test_advanced_cli_parsers.py::
test_audit_cli_unknown_subcommand_exits_2_through_the_factory.

Noted for possible follow-up, deliberately OUT of this ticket's file_impact: the same three-type
spelling still appears independently at src/rebar/_engine_support/gates.py:25
(_GATE_EXEMPT_TYPES), src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py:647,
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/config.py:69 (EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES) and
src/rebar/reducer/_api.py:23 (_NON_GRAPH_ARTIFACT_TYPES). They answer different questions
(close gate / sync exclusion / non-graph artifacts), so consolidating them is separate work.
